definition: ἀντί-τυπος, -ον (see: τύπος), [in LXX: Est.3:13 A * ;] __1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse.  __2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word);  __(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), Heb.9:24;  __(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), 1Pe.3:21 (Cramer, 357).† (AS)
